paths.linkedom: The presentational shell composes pages as append-only HTML strings. Re-parsing composed page markup through a DOM serializer (linkedom/jsdom) drops one level of &-escaping and collapses the reader iframe's intentionally double-escaped srcdoc into live elements (a `<input>` code sample renders as a real input). Keep shell transforms string-based (see injectPageStylesIntoMain); parse only network-boundary fragments — changelog-banner.ts is the exempt exception.
